title: Tensor square for the fixed coordinate stalk map
statement: For the cartesian scheme square, E,K,K', the derived map phi, the canonical tensor comparison tau with its specified counit equation, and coordinates c,d as defined in [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], fix a K-flat sheaf complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex] with a derived isomorphism Q(P) to E. At a point z use the actual rings R,A,B,C and scalar-extension functors F,G of [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Put U=P_{g'(z)}, Q=c.P_{g'(z)}, N=c.N_z, and t=tensorStalkIso(c.P);(c.t)_z : F(Q) to N. For the canonical base-derived cohomology model m_U of U tensor_A Q [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], in every degree i there are C-linear source and target isomorphisms a_U,b_U making a_U;stalkComparison(d,z,i) equal to m_U.localizedComparison(i);H^i(mu_F(U,Q)^{-1};(F(U) tensor t));b_U. The complexes and map are fixed, no assertion of flatness of C or invertibility of horizontal comparisons is made, and the original comparison square is not part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Obtain the tensor coordinates e and the source and target chain isomorphisms sigma,rho from the chain-level tensor coordinate theorem. Their square is an equality of chain maps, before cohomology.

Apply exists_baseDerivedTensorModel_quasiIso_comparison to sigma.hom, a chain isomorphism, using the canonical model mU and cohomologyModel(e.P). Apply homology to the chain equation and use homologyMap_comp. Postcompose the model comparison equality with homology of tensorStalkIso(e.P) and S(e.t). Transitivity yields the fixed-map square in coordinates e.

The proved private normalization helper uses c.represents to solve for Q(c.t), then comparisonStalkHomologyIso_naturality to express stalkComparison as comparisonIntoPullback followed by derived stalk cohomology of pullback(c.e.hom);phi;c.e-prime inverse and the homology identification. The proved coordinate-transport helper applies exists_comparisonSourceIso to e.e;d.e inverse and comparisonIntoPullback_naturality. Its target isomorphism is stalk cohomology of e.e-prime;d.e-prime inverse conjugated by the homology identifications. Functor laws and inverse cancellation give its square. Compose this source isomorphism with extension of the model isomorphism, and this target isomorphism with homology of rho. Reassociation gives the required equation for d.

theorem tensorStalkComparison_fixedMap_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (E K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K.obj ⟶ K'.obj)
    (τ : ∀ A B : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback g').obj (A ⊗ B) ⟶
        (derivedPullback g').obj A ⊗ (derivedPullback g').obj B)
    (hτ : IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison g' τ)
    (c : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' K.obj K'.obj φ)
    (d : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' (E.obj ⊗ K.obj)
      (((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj) ⊗ K'.obj)
      (τ E.obj K.obj ≫ ((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj ◁ φ)))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ E.obj) (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (z : X') :
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z))
    let R := SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z
    let A := SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' z
    let B := SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z
    let C := SingleComplexBaseChange.C z
    let F := (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C).comp
        (algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C)
    let S := (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace z).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let U := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z P
    let Q := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z c.P
    let t := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z c.P).hom ≫ S.map c.t
    let mU := ModuleCat.baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C
    ∀ i : ℤ,
      ∃ (aU : G.obj (mU.cohomology i) ≅
          G.obj ((SingleComplexBaseChange.cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z d.P).cohomology i))
        (bU : (F.obj U ⊗ S.obj c.N).homology i ≅ (S.obj d.N).homology i),
        aU.hom ≫ SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison f f' g g' sq d z i =
          mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i ≫ bU.hom
